sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯 DealBook 报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mamdani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·曼达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews at nytimes.com and in the Times app on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过 nytimes.com 和《纽约时报》应用程序直播部分采访内容。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日简报》。

sentences.en: Today, as the White House battles leak after leak, is there an organized network trying to undermine the Trump presidency from inside the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，随着白宫不断遭遇泄密事件，美国政府内部是否存在一个试图破坏特朗普总统任期的有组织网络？

sentences.en: government?
sentences.zh: 政府？

sentences.en: Then, who are the 500 private citizens with unprecedented access to Donald Trump on the weekends?
sentences.zh: 此外，周末能以史无前例的方式接触唐纳德·特朗普的那500名私人公民是谁？

sentences.en: The Times unmasks the secret list of Mar-a-Lago members.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》揭开了海湖庄园会员的秘密名单。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, February 21St.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月21日，星期二。

sentences.en: Yes, John.
sentences.zh: 是的，约翰。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.en: What will you do on the leaks you've said twice today?
sentences.zh: 你今天两次提到泄密事件，你打算怎么处理？

sentences.en: Yes, well, looking at them very, very, very serious.
sentences.zh: 是的，嗯，我们正在非常、非常、非常严肃地看待这些事件。

sentences.en: I've gone to all of the folks in charge of the various agencies, and I've actually called the Justice Department to look into the leaks.
sentences.zh: 我已经找了各机构的负责人，实际上我已经要求司法部调查这些泄密事件。

sentences.en: Those are criminal leaks.
sentences.zh: 那些是犯罪性的泄密。

sentences.en: In recent days, we've started to hear talk of a possible explanation for this cascade of government leaks that have so inflamed President Trump since his inauguration.
sentences.zh: 最近几天，我们开始听到对这一连串政府泄密事件的可能解释，这些泄密让特朗普总统自就职以来一直非常愤怒。

sentences.en: We are looking into that very seriously.
sentences.zh: 我们正在非常严肃地调查此事。

sentences.en: It's a criminal act.
sentences.zh: 这是一种犯罪行为。

sentences.en: Leaks of his executive orders before they're issued, of classified conversations with foreign leaders, and of infighting inside the White House.
sentences.zh: 行政命令在发布前被泄露，与外国领导人的机密谈话被泄露，白宫内部的内斗也被泄露。

sentences.en: The source, we're told, may be something that could define this new presidency as much as the president himself.
sentences.zh: 据称，泄密源头可能与总统本人一样，足以定义这一届新政府。

sentences.en: It's called...
sentences.zh: 它被称为……

sentences.en: The Deep State.
sentences.zh: “深层政府”。

sentences.en: Some supporters of Trump, including Breitbart News, are now accusing the intelligence agencies of attempting to wage a deep state coup against the president.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的一些支持者，包括布赖特巴特新闻网，现在指责情报机构试图对总统发动一场“深层政府”政变。

sentences.en: The American deep state of government agencies and military intelligence has, in effect, gone to war with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 由政府机构和军事情报部门组成的美国“深层政府”实际上已经向唐纳德·特朗普宣战了。

sentences.en: I think it's really the deep state versus the president.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实是“深层政府”与总统之间的较量。

sentences.en: They typically exercise their power in secret, in the dark.
sentences.zh: 他们通常在秘密中、在暗处行使权力。

sentences.en: The deep state is the notion that leaders come and go, but there's a permanent bureaucracy, and often it refers to the security bureaucracy,
sentences.zh: “深层政府”的概念是指领导人来来去去，但存在一个永久的官僚机构，通常指的是安全官僚机构，

sentences.en: the military and the intelligence agencies, and that they kind of go on.
sentences.zh: 即军队和情报机构，他们会一直存在下去。

sentences.en: Scott Shane has covered national security and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 斯科特·谢恩几十年来一直报道国家安全和美国

sentences.en: intelligence community for decades.
sentences.zh: 情报界。

sentences.en: And that, you know, that in some ways, what happens at the top of a government may be, to a greater or lesser degree, window dressing,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在某种程度上，政府高层发生的事情可能在很大程度上只是门面功夫，

sentences.en: and that, you know, sort of beneath the surface are the real powers that decide what's going to happen, and that sometimes discard the nominal leaders
sentences.zh: 你知道，在表面之下是决定未来走向的真正权力，有时他们会抛弃名义上的领导人，

sentences.en: and replace them with somebody else.
sentences.zh: 并用其他人取而代之。

sentences.en: An example that's sort of close to my heart, I lived in Russia and reported from Moscow, in the Gorbachev era.
sentences.zh: 一个我深有感触的例子是，我曾在戈尔巴乔夫时代的莫斯科居住并进行报道。

sentences.en: And it was, you know, a very tumultuous time when essentially people were overthrowing peacefully the Communist Party and the Soviet state.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常动荡的时期，人们基本上是在和平地推翻共产党和苏联国家。

sentences.en: The KGB was denounced publicly.
sentences.zh: 克格勃受到了公开谴责。

sentences.en: And, you know, a lot of us thought, wow, you know, well, that's over.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们很多人当时想，哇，那一切都结束了。

sentences.en: The Soviet system is gone.
sentences.zh: 苏联体制已经不复存在了。

sentences.en: The KGB is out of luck.
sentences.zh: 克格勃也完了。

sentences.en: Well, then, you know, what happens?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么，后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: And basically, you know, almost a decade pass, and then who becomes president?
sentences.zh: 基本上，几乎十年过去了，谁成了总统？

sentences.en: Well, a kind of mid-level KGB guy named Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一个名叫弗拉基米尔·普京的中层克格勃人员。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think that was very much the deep state resurfacing to take control.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为那在很大程度上是“深层政府”重新浮出水面以夺取控制权。

sentences.en: But I think that's what we mean by deep.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这就是我们所说的“深”的意思。

sentences.en: It's sort of buried down there, and every once in a while, it can sort of rise up and assert its power.
sentences.zh: 它被埋在下面，偶尔会浮出水面并宣示其权力。

sentences.en: So is that what's happening right now in the United States?
sentences.zh: 那么，美国现在发生的情况也是这样吗？

sentences.en: Well, I think there's a huge difference between a country like Russia and the United States.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为俄罗斯这样的国家和美国之间有巨大的区别。

sentences.en: We may have a deep state, but it's not nearly as powerful as it is in many other countries.
sentences.zh: 我们可能有一个“深层政府”，但它远没有在许多其他国家那样强大。

sentences.en: I think there are so many competing power centers here that, you know, the suggestion that the deep state is one thing, it's a sort of unified, shadowy bunch of guys,
sentences.zh: 我认为这里有太多的竞争权力中心，所以，认为“深层政府”是一个单一的、统一的、阴暗的团体的说法，

sentences.en: you know, who sit around and saying, well, now we're going to make our move.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们坐在一起说，好吧，现在我们要采取行动了。

sentences.en: We're going to undermine Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我们要破坏唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: I just think that's bogus when applied to the United States.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这种说法应用到美国身上是虚假的。

sentences.en: I think it sort of misrepresents the reality of how this country operates.
sentences.zh: 我认为这在某种程度上歪曲了这个国家运作的现实。

sentences.en: But, you know, I am reminded of way back in the 90s, when I was at the Baltimore Sun, I did a sort of explanatory series about the National Security Agency.
sentences.zh: 但是，我回想起90年代，当时我在《巴尔的摩太阳报》工作，我做过一系列关于国家安全局的解释性报道。

sentences.en: And there was a deputy director of NSA who'd been there for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 当时有一位在国安局工作了许多年的副局长。

sentences.en: And he was a bureaucrat.
sentences.zh: 他是个官僚。

sentences.en: He was, you know, sort of permanent there.
sentences.zh: 他，你知道，在那里是永久性的。

sentences.en: And usually the head of NSA is a general or an admiral who comes in for a term of three years or five years.
sentences.zh: 通常国安局局长是一位将军或海军上将，任期为三年或五年。

sentences.en: So the directors come and go, but the deputy directors stay for much longer.
sentences.zh: 所以局长们来来去去，但副局长们留任的时间要长得多。

sentences.en: And, you know, people told me that this deputy director would wait for a year or two to see whether he could trust the new director before he would let the new director of the NSA
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，人们告诉我，这位副局长会等上一两年，看看他是否能信任新局长，然后才会让新局长

sentences.en: in on some of the more sensitive programs that the agency was running.
sentences.zh: 接触该机构正在运行的一些更敏感的项目。

sentences.en: Now, that does give you a sense of how the deep state can operate, you know, in a place like the NSA.
sentences.zh: 这确实让你感觉到“深层政府”在国安局这样的地方是如何运作的。

sentences.en: But I don't think it's a term that describes what's really happening in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这个词并不能描述美国目前发生的事情，

sentences.en: for the most part.
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上是这样。

sentences.en: And yet it feels like there is something distinct going on here.
sentences.zh: 然而，感觉这里确实发生了一些独特的事情。

sentences.en: And I guess that gets back to what Trump has done.
sentences.zh: 我想这又回到了特朗普所做的事情上。

sentences.en: And it is perhaps to have essentially questioned the fundamental workings of government bureaucracy, right?
sentences.zh: 他或许从根本上质疑了政府官僚机构的基本运作方式，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, it's certainly true that there are a lot of people upset with the new administration, which to some degree, you know, is always true.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当然，确实有很多人对新政府感到不满，这在某种程度上一直都是事实。

sentences.en: This is just a much more dramatic, obviously, change of direction, which produces more leaks.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一个更剧烈的方向转变，从而产生了更多的泄密。

sentences.en: I mean, under Bush, we learned that the CIA had secret prisons, that the CIA was using so-called enhanced interrogation techniques, you know, which were essentially,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在布什政府时期，我们了解到中央情报局有秘密监狱，中情局正在使用所谓的强化审讯技术，你知道，这本质上，

sentences.en: in many cases, torture.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，就是酷刑。

sentences.en: The NSA was eavesdropping inside the United States without court orders, without warrants.
sentences.zh: 国安局在没有法院命令、没有搜查令的情况下在美国境内进行窃听。

sentences.en: All those things came from leakers.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情都是泄密者披露的。

sentences.en: So I think we're seeing sort of the traditional leaker whistleblower role, which is a standard part of the functioning of American society and American government.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们看到的是传统的泄密者和举报人的角色，这是美国社会和美国政府运作的标准组成部分。

sentences.en: I think we're just seeing that sort of on steroids for a while.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们只是看到这种角色在一段时间内被“打了鸡血”。

sentences.en: And finally, do you think that what we're calling here, although this is an evolving phrase, the deep state, is it trying to end the presidency of Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 最后，你认为我们在这里所说的——尽管这是一个不断演变的短语——“深层政府”，它是在试图终结唐纳德·特朗普的总统任期吗？

sentences.en: Or is it just trying to find ways to hold it accountable, to hold it in check?
sentences.zh: 还是它只是在试图寻找方法来追究其责任，对其进行制衡？

sentences.en: I think, you know, that's the problem with calling something in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这就是在美国称呼某事物为“深层政府”的问题所在，

sentences.en: the deep state, you know, because they're basically individuals scattered through the government.
sentences.zh: 因为他们基本上是分散在政府各处的个人。

sentences.en: Some are determined to end Donald Trump's presidency and will do everything within their power to, you know, help with that cause.
sentences.zh: 有些人决心终结唐纳德·特朗普的总统任期，并将尽其所能帮助实现这一目标。

sentences.en: Others totally accept the idea that Trump is president and may admire certain things about him.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则完全接受特朗普是总统这一事实，甚至可能钦佩他的一些特质。

sentences.en: But, you know, they have a program that they don't want to die or they have another program they want to promote.
sentences.zh: 但是，他们有自己不想放弃的项目，或者有他们想要推广的其他项目。

sentences.en: But I do think the, you know, the tensions between the bureaucracy and the president may be greater at this moment than in any other time in modern American history.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，官僚机构与总统之间的紧张关系在这一刻可能比现代美国历史上的任何时候都要大。

sentences.en: And so it does seem very likely that there are going to be some real collisions, you know, before they work out some kind of way of working with one another
sentences.zh: 因此，在他们找到某种合作方式使政府正常运作之前，很可能会发生一些真正的冲突，

sentences.en: to make the government function.
sentences.zh: 这是很可能的。

sentences.en: Scott, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 斯科特，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Dana.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫达娜。

sentences.en: I am a subscriber to The New York Times, but my husband isn't.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的订阅用户，但我丈夫不是。

sentences.en: And it would be really nice to be able to share a recipe or an article or compete with him in Wordle or Connections.
sentences.zh: 如果能和他分享食谱或文章，或者在 Wordle 或 Connections 游戏中和他一较高下，那该多好。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Dana, we heard you.
sentences.zh: 达娜，我们听到了你的心声。

sentences.en: It's why we created the New York Times Family Subscription.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们创建《纽约时报》家庭订阅服务的原因。

sentences.en: One subscription, up to four separate logins for anyone in your life.
sentences.zh: 一份订阅，最多可供你生活中的四个人分别登录。

sentences.en: Find out more at nytimes.com slash family.
sentences.zh: 详情请访问 nytimes.com/family。

sentences.en: Palm Beach is home to one of the most famous estates in the world,
sentences.zh: 棕榈滩拥有世界上最著名的庄园之一，

sentences.en: Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 海湖庄园。

sentences.en: It's the crown jewel in a vast real estate empire.
sentences.zh: 它是庞大房地产帝国中的皇冠明珠。

sentences.en: It is 110,000 square feet of opulence that has been painstakingly restored to its original condition by a famous businessman who knew a good thing when he saw it.
sentences.zh: 它占地11万平方英尺，极尽奢华，由一位慧眼识珠的著名商人精心修复至原始状态。

sentences.en: Purchased by Donald Trump in 1985.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普于1985年购入。

sentences.en: Well, I think Mar-a-Lago is certainly the most spectacular state in the United States.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为海湖庄园无疑是美国最壮观的庄园。

sentences.en: And interestingly, when Prince Charles came to Palm Beach, he came to play polo
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，当查尔斯王子来到棕榈滩时，他是来打马球的，

sentences.en: and to see Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 并参观了海湖庄园。

sentences.en: And the first thing he did is see Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 他做的第一件事就是参观海湖庄园。

sentences.en: And I say, you may be the only person I know that has a house that's nicer than this, meaning Buckingham Palace.
sentences.zh: 我说，你可能是我认识的唯一一个拥有比这更好的房子的人，指的是白金汉宫。

sentences.en: And he said, well, I'm not so sure about that.
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，我对此不太确定。

sentences.en: 31 years later,
sentences.zh: 31年后，

sentences.en: Trump is president and Mar-a-Lago is his weekend retreat.
sentences.zh: 特朗普成为了总统，海湖庄园成了他的周末度假地。

sentences.en: So it's a private club that was initially a private property by Marjorie Merriweather PoSt.
sentences.zh: 所以它是一个私人俱乐部，最初是玛乔丽·梅里韦瑟·波斯特的私人财产。
zh_words: 玛乔丽·梅里韦瑟·波斯特

sentences.en: My colleague Maggie Haberman covers the White House and she's been to Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 我的同事玛吉·哈伯曼负责报道白宫，她去过海湖庄园。

sentences.en: She was sort of a socialite and she had this vision of turning this property into literally a winter White House.
sentences.zh: 她当时算是一位名流，她设想将这处房产真正变成“冬季白宫”。

sentences.en: That was what she talked about and that's why she donated it to the federal government.
sentences.zh: 这就是她所谈论的，也是她将其捐赠给联邦政府的原因。

sentences.en: The federal government had so no intereSt.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府对此毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: So Trump was able to purchase it after negotiating and he was very clever about how he did it, but he was able to kind of back the government into a corner
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普在谈判后成功买下了它，他在处理方式上非常聪明，他通过收购不同的地块，成功地将政府逼入死角。

sentences.en: by picking up different parcels.
sentences.zh: 在90年代，当他面临各种破产危机时，他将其改造成了一个私人俱乐部，一个会员制俱乐部。

sentences.en: In the 90s, when he was facing various, I believe, various bankruptcies, he turned it into a private club, a members-only club.
sentences.zh: 自特朗普当选以来，记者们一直在试图弄清楚还有谁和他共享这处庄园。

sentences.en: Since Trump's election, reporters have been trying to figure out who else shares the estate with him.
sentences.zh: 那些愿意支付每年高达20万美元会员费的人。

sentences.en: People willing to pay membership fees of up to $200,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 玛吉获得了一份会员名单，并与政治记者尼克·孔费索里合作追踪了他们。

sentences.en: Maggie obtained a list of the members and worked with political reporter
sentences.zh: 所以你可以走进这个地方，在这里闲逛，就这样见到总统，因为这是他的家。

sentences.en: Nick Confessori to track them down.
sentences.zh: 而且他对此非常自豪。

sentences.en: So you can walk into this place, hang out in this place and see the president just like that because it is his home.
sentences.zh: 我在新年前夕去过那里，当时他还是当选总统。

sentences.en: And he's also, he's really proud of it.
sentences.zh: 我是作为某人的客人去的，特朗普和我作为报道对象和记者，关系很复杂。

sentences.en: I was there right before New Year's when he was still the president-elect.
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: I went to someone's guest and Trump and I have a complicated relationship as subject and reporter.
sentences.zh: 正如他与许多对他进行过严谨报道的记者关系一样，但我报道他也已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: Do you?
sentences.zh: 我在那里见到他时，他非常和蔼，但他显然对这个地方非常自豪。

sentences.en: As he does with many reporters who have covered him rigorously, but I've also covered him for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他在做他经常做的事情，当你在他的某处房产里时。

sentences.en: And he was very pleasant when I saw him there, but he was clearly very proud of it.
sentences.zh: 他会带你参观，充当导游。

sentences.en: You know, he was doing what he often does when you're around him at one of his properties.
sentences.zh: 他现在当了总统后不再这样做了，但他过去常像迎宾员一样在餐桌间走动。

sentences.en: He's kind of showing you things and playing tour guide.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢和人在一起。

sentences.en: He doesn't do this really as president anymore, but he used to walk from table to table like a greeter.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢不断的输入和接触。

sentences.en: He loves being around people.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢举办这种大型派对。

sentences.en: He loves the constant inputs and contacts.
sentences.zh: 那么海湖庄园的会员都是谁呢？

sentences.en: And he likes hosting this big party.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是特朗普的老朋友和新朋友的混合体，有医生、律师、牙医。

sentences.en: So who are the members of Mar-a-Lago?
sentences.zh: 我们应该说，你知道，这些会员大多数就是会员，这首先是一个社交俱乐部，但恰好他们也有这些政治和政策利益，

sentences.en: Well, it's a mixture of old Trump friends and new Trump friends, doctors, lawyers, dentists.
sentences.zh: 这些利益将与总统的角色产生交集。

sentences.en: We should say, you know, most of these members are members and it's a social club first, but it happens that they also have these political and policy interests
sentences.zh: 现在他们拥有了这种前所未有的，完全，你知道，

sentences.en: that are going to intersect with the president's role.
sentences.zh: 我找不到词来形容了，因为总统历史上从来没有过这样的事情。

sentences.en: And now they have this unprecedented and totally, you know,
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: I'm out of words for it because there isn't anything like this in presidential history.
sentences.zh: 这是一个总统的夏季住所或“冬季白宫”，人们花钱来这里拜访他。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 这在任何美国总统身上都从未发生过，包括我们所有拥有豪宅并会去海德公园或肯纳邦克波特度假的富有的总统们，

sentences.en: It is a summer residence or a winter White House for the president where people pay to come visit him.
sentences.zh: 他们去那里是为了处理公务。

sentences.en: And that has never existed for any American president, including all the rich ones we've had with mansions who would retreat to Hyde Park or Kennebunkport
sentences.zh: 他们去那里是为了处理公务。

sentences.en: and do the people's business.
sentences.zh: 他们去那里是为了处理公务。

sentences.en: This is different.
sentences.zh: 这很不一样。

sentences.en: You have that and then people pay to come see you and hang out.
sentences.zh: 你拥有那个地方，然后人们付钱来看你，和你待在一起。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's as if Crawford were somehow charging rent while George W.
sentences.zh: 这就像是克劳福德在乔治·W·布什居住期间，

sentences.en: Bush was in residence.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上还在收租一样。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: According to the club officials, interest has spiked since he became president.
sentences.zh: 据俱乐部官员称，自从他当选总统以来，人们的兴趣激增。

sentences.en: So, you know, there is clearly some value-add proposition for some people, whether it's doing business or just proximity to power.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，对于某些人来说，这显然存在某种增值主张，无论是为了做生意还是仅仅为了接近权力。

sentences.en: But it does raise this interesting question, especially because unlike the White House where we get visitors logs, we have no idea who is going in and out of Mar-a-Lago
sentences.zh: 但这确实引发了一个有趣的问题，特别是因为与我们有访客记录的白宫不同，我们根本不知道谁进出了海湖庄园，

sentences.en: because the membership list is not public.
sentences.zh: 因为会员名单是不公开的。

sentences.en: We were able to review three different versions of it.
sentences.zh: 我们设法查阅了三个不同版本的名单。

sentences.en: But members can also bring guests and that's not public at all.
sentences.zh: 但会员也可以带客人，而这些客人完全是不公开的。

sentences.en: And so you could be a member and have as many as 10 guests a night and that's complicated.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能是一名会员，一晚上带多达10位客人，这就很复杂了。

sentences.en: So you guys have talked, both of you, to a bunch of these members.
sentences.zh: 所以你们俩都和这些会员中的很多人谈过。

sentences.en: What have they been telling you about their experience at the club recently?
sentences.zh: 他们最近向你们讲述了在俱乐部里的什么经历？

sentences.en: A bunch of them said, no, thank you, and hung up.
sentences.zh: 他们中的很多人说“不，谢谢”，然后就挂断了电话。

sentences.en: But those who didn't do that
sentences.zh: 但那些没有挂断的人，

sentences.en: say that it's become a different experience, that it is much more crowded.
sentences.zh: 说这已经变成了一种不同的体验，变得拥挤多了。

sentences.en: I spoke to Jeff Green who is a billionaire real estate developer.
sentences.zh: 我采访了亿万富翁房地产开发商杰夫·格林。

sentences.en: He said he likes it.
sentences.zh: 他说他喜欢这样。

sentences.en: He said he just finds it sort of engaging and he likes being around
sentences.zh: 他说他只是觉得这很有趣，而且他喜欢在那种环境下，

sentences.en: Trump in that setting.
sentences.zh: 待在特朗普身边。

sentences.en: He described Trump to me at the time as, you know, it's sort of like going to Disneyland and knowing that Mickey Mouse is there every day now.
sentences.zh: 当时他向我描述特朗普时说，你知道，这就像去迪士尼乐园，而且知道米老鼠现在每天都在那里一样。

sentences.en: And he did not mean that offensively.
sentences.zh: 他并不是冒犯的意思。

sentences.en: He really didn't.
sentences.zh: 他真的没有。

sentences.en: But he is emblematic, I think, of a lot of experiences that people are having.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，他象征着许多人正在经历的事情。

sentences.en: They're dying to be around him on a normal day because he's a celebrity and he's the owner of the club.
sentences.zh: 他们渴望在平常的日子里待在他身边，因为他是名人，也是俱乐部的主人。

sentences.en: And now it's just taken on this different patina.
sentences.zh: 而现在，这已经带上了一种不同的色彩。

sentences.en: What are members telling you, Nick?
sentences.zh: 尼克，会员们是怎么告诉你的？

sentences.en: Well, the ones who have talked to us have said, this is a social club.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那些和我们交谈过的人说，这是一个社交俱乐部。

sentences.en: You know, we're not there to see Trump.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们去那里不是为了见特朗普。

sentences.en: So they're a bit defensive about the idea that this is about proximity to power.
sentences.zh: 所以对于“这是为了接近权力”这种说法，他们有点抵触。

sentences.en: But it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 但这很有趣。

sentences.en: Proximity can breed influence in ways that are not always intended by the people who are nearby.
sentences.zh: 接近权力可能会以一种接近的人并未预料到的方式滋生影响力。

sentences.en: So one great anecdote from Richard Lafrac, who Maggie spoke to.
sentences.zh: 玛吉采访过理查德·拉弗拉克，他有一个很棒的轶事。

sentences.en: Richard Lafrac, who is this developer from New York, who's another one of these snowbirds who goes down to Florida.
sentences.zh: 理查德·拉弗拉克是来自纽约的开发商，也是那些去佛罗里达过冬的候鸟之一。

sentences.en: He's there talking to the president and Mr. Trump kind of brings up the wall, like how to build the wall of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他在那里和总统交谈，特朗普先生提到了那堵墙，比如如何建造墨西哥边境墙。

sentences.en: The wall.
sentences.zh: 那堵墙。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The wall.
sentences.zh: 那堵墙。

sentences.en: And he asked, how come you can't do it, Richard?
sentences.zh: 他问，理查德，你为什么不能做呢？

sentences.en: He said the price is too much.
sentences.zh: 他说价格太高了。

sentences.en: And he said, would you consider this?
sentences.zh: 然后他说，你会考虑这个吗？

sentences.en: So just to clarify, the president turns to a developer,
sentences.zh: 所以澄清一下，总统转向一位开发商，

sentences.en: friend, member of the club and says, I guess somewhat playfully, but who knows?
sentences.zh: 一位朋友，俱乐部的会员，然后说，我想多少有点开玩笑的成分，但谁知道呢？

sentences.en: No, I think...
sentences.zh: 不，我想……

sentences.en: Why can't you just build the wall between Mexico and Italy?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不能直接在墨西哥和意大利之间建那堵墙呢？

sentences.en: Mr. Lafrac said,
sentences.zh: 拉弗拉克先生说，

sentences.en: I'd heard about it from someone else and I called him to talk to him about it.
sentences.zh: 我从别人那里听说过这件事，我打电话给他谈过。

sentences.en: He seemed to, he was a little startled that I knew about it and he was also a little startled that Trump had said it.
sentences.zh: 他似乎……他对我了解这件事感到有点惊讶，而且他也对特朗普说过这话感到有点惊讶。

sentences.en: But the way he described it as a very brief passing moment in a conversation that was a social call that he was paying to Trump, and he is truly a friend of Trump's,
sentences.zh: 但他描述的方式是，这只是他在拜访特朗普时进行的一次社交谈话中非常短暂的瞬间，而且他确实是特朗普的朋友，

sentences.en: where they were talking about,
sentences.zh: 当时他们正在谈论，

sentences.en: I guess Trump brought up the wall and he said that he had seen estimates that he considered absurd of like $20 billion or what the cost would be.
sentences.zh: 我想是特朗普提到了那堵墙，他说他看到的估价是200亿美元，他认为这很荒谬，或者说成本会是多少。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, would you consider doing it?
sentences.zh: 然后他说，你知道，你会考虑做这件事吗？

sentences.en: And Lafrac said sort of, I thought you were having the Department of Homeland Security deal with this.
sentences.zh: 拉弗拉克说，我以为你正让国土安全部处理这件事。

sentences.en: And Trump said, yes, yes, you know, I may have General Kelly call you,
sentences.zh: 特朗普说，是的，是的，你知道，我可能会让凯利将军给你打电话，

sentences.en: Kelly meaning
sentences.zh: 凯利指的是，

sentences.en: Department of Homeland Security
sentences.zh: 国土安全部，

sentences.en: Chief John Kelly.
sentences.zh: 约翰·凯利部长。

sentences.en: And Lafrac made clear to me that he has no interest in doing this.
sentences.zh: 拉弗拉克向我明确表示，他对做这件事毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: He was struck by how his friend who was used to being sort of this get what I want when I want developer is at the mercy of this massive procurement process and is discovering
sentences.zh: 他感到震惊的是，他的这位朋友，过去习惯于那种“想要什么就得到什么”的开发商，现在却受制于这种庞大的采购流程，并发现，

sentences.en: that the gears of government turn pretty slowly.
sentences.zh: 政府的齿轮转动得相当缓慢。

sentences.en: The story with Lafrac actually makes an interesting point as well, which is, this is not necessarily a den of corruption, right?
sentences.zh: 关于拉弗拉克的故事实际上也提出了一个有趣的观点，那就是，这不一定是一个腐败窝点，对吧？

sentences.en: But it shows that in his way,
sentences.zh: 但这表明，以他自己的方式，

sentences.en: Trump is sort of parochial and his New York circle, his personal circle, is sort of his political circle and his presidential circle.
sentences.zh: 特朗普有点狭隘，他的纽约圈子、他的个人圈子，某种程度上就是他的政治圈子和总统圈子。

sentences.en: So the people he seeks for advice are the people within arm's reach.
sentences.zh: 所以他寻求建议的人就是他触手可及的人。

sentences.en: So the big and maybe somewhat unanswerable question is are these members actively angling for influence with the president or with his aides when they're down there?
sentences.zh: 所以一个重大且可能无法回答的问题是，当这些会员在下面时，他们是否在积极地寻求与总统或他的助手建立影响力？

sentences.en: Do we know?
sentences.zh: 我们知道吗？

sentences.en: We don't know for sure, but I think it's clear that they have influence even if they aren't angling for it.
sentences.zh: 我们不能确定，但我认为很明显，即使他们没有刻意寻求，他们也拥有影响力。

sentences.en: That's what they are.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的身份。

sentences.en: They are present.
sentences.zh: 他们就在现场。

sentences.en: They're being asked their advice on major initiatives and they could give good advice.
sentences.zh: 他们被征求对重大倡议的建议，而且他们可能会给出好的建议。

sentences.en: But again, this intersection here of the public and the private and the personal and public policy is unprecedented in American history.
sentences.zh: 但再说一次，这种公共与私人、个人与公共政策的交集在美国历史上是前所未有的。

sentences.en: There was a pretty remarkable scene at Mar-a-Lago about a week or so ago that illustrated all the quandaries of having the presidency move to a members-only club
sentences.zh: 大约一周前，海湖庄园发生了一幕非常引人注目的场景，它说明了将总统府搬到一个仅限会员的俱乐部所带来的所有困境，

sentences.en: that has lots of people who are outside of the presidential orbit, which was that the prime minister of Japan,
sentences.zh: 那里有很多总统圈子之外的人，那就是日本首相，

sentences.en: Shinzo Abe, and Donald Trump learn about the ballistic missile launch out of North Korea in real time.
sentences.zh: 安倍晋三和唐纳德·特朗普实时了解了朝鲜发射弹道导弹的消息。

sentences.en: How should we think about the fact that that occurred there?
sentences.zh: 我们应该如何看待这件事发生在那里？

sentences.en: I don't think the problem was that it occurred there.
sentences.zh: 我不认为问题在于它发生在那里。

sentences.en: I think the problem was that they continued over their steaks on the patio.
sentences.zh: 我认为问题在于他们继续在露台上吃着牛排。

sentences.en: There was a problem of sort of government as like dinner theater for the Mar-a-Lago attendees.
sentences.zh: 这存在一种政府就像是海湖庄园与会者的晚餐剧场的问题。

sentences.en: And that really was what this was like.
sentences.zh: 而这确实就是当时的情况。

sentences.en: This guy who posted like play-by-plays on Facebook of here they are, here's somebody using an iPhone flashlight to help Trump see documents better.
sentences.zh: 这个在Facebook上发布现场直播的家伙，这里是他们，这里有人用iPhone手电筒帮助特朗普更好地看清文件。

sentences.en: Also posted a picture of himself posing with the person who carries the nuclear codes.
sentences.zh: 他还发布了一张自己与携带核密码的人合影的照片。

sentences.en: That was striking.
sentences.zh: 这令人震惊。

sentences.en: And right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think Americans may question that.
sentences.zh: 我想美国人可能会质疑这一点。

sentences.en: I want to ask you both how central you think
sentences.zh: 我想问你们俩，你们认为

sentences.en: Mar-a-Lago is going to keep being to the Trump presidency.
sentences.zh: 海湖庄园在特朗普总统任期内会保持多核心的地位？

sentences.en: Extremely.
sentences.zh: 非常核心。

sentences.en: I think it's going to be the White House two or three days a week and on vacations for the next four years.
sentences.zh: 我认为在接下来的四年里，它将成为每周两到三天的白宫，以及度假地。

sentences.en: I've been covering this man for, you know, in various points for 20 years-ish.
sentences.zh: 我报道这个人已经，你知道，在过去20年左右的不同时间点。

sentences.en: This is the happiest
sentences.zh: 这是我见过他最开心的时候，

sentences.en: I've ever seen him is when he is there.
sentences.zh: 就是当他在那里的时候。

sentences.en: He is relaxed.
sentences.zh: 他很放松。

sentences.en: He's able to move around.
sentences.zh: 他能够四处走动。

sentences.en: Mar-a-Lago, he gets to just kind of be free.
sentences.zh: 在海湖庄园，他可以变得自由自在。

sentences.en: He is not somebody who really likes going out to other people's restaurants.
sentences.zh: 他并不是一个真正喜欢去别人餐厅的人。

sentences.en: He likes being at his own properties.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢待在自己的房产里。

sentences.en: He always has.
sentences.zh: 他一直都是这样。

sentences.en: He flew home almost every night during the campaign to sleep in his own bed.
sentences.zh: 竞选期间，他几乎每天晚上都飞回家睡在自己的床上。

sentences.en: This is a place where he can be a little freer.
sentences.zh: 这是一个他可以更自由一点的地方。

sentences.en: Thank you both.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们俩。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: So I just wanted to announce we've been working all weekend very diligently, very hard.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想宣布，我们整个周末都在非常勤奋、非常努力地工作。

sentences.en: After a highly public search,
sentences.zh: 经过一次高度公开的搜寻，

sentences.en: President Trump has chosen a replacement for Michael Flynn.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统已经为迈克尔·弗林选定了一位继任者。

sentences.en: General H.R.
sentences.zh: H.R.麦克马斯特将军

sentences.en: McMaster will become the national
sentences.zh: 将成为国家

sentences.en: security advisor.
sentences.zh: 安全顾问。

sentences.en: He's a man of tremendous talent and tremendous experience.
sentences.zh: 他是一位拥有巨大才华和丰富经验的人。

sentences.en: The president announced the choice on Monday from Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 总统周一在海湖庄园宣布了这一选择。

sentences.en: Mr. President, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，非常感谢。

sentences.en: I'd just like to say what a privilege it is to be able to continue serving our nation.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，能够继续为我们的国家服务是多么荣幸。

sentences.en: I'm grateful to you for that opportunity and I look forward to joining the national security team and doing everything I can to advance and protect the interests
sentences.zh: 我很感谢您给我这个机会，我期待着加入国家安全团队，并尽我所能推进和保护美国人民的利益。

sentences.en: of the American people.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 你一定会做得很好。

sentences.en: You're going to do a great job.
sentences.zh: 以下是我们对麦克马斯特的了解。

sentences.en: Here's what we know about McMaster.
sentences.zh: 他写了一本书，

sentences.en: He wrote a book,
sentences.zh: 《失职》，关于美国将军在越战期间未能反抗文职上级的失败。

sentences.en: Derelection of Duty, about the failure of American generals to stand up to civilian superiors during the Vietnam War.
sentences.zh: 并且他公开批评了小布什白宫在伊拉克的决定。

sentences.en: And he openly criticized decisions made by the second
sentences.zh: 我们就像盲人一样，

sentences.en: Bush White House in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 麦克马斯特说，试图做正确的事，却破坏了很多东西。

sentences.en: We were like a blind man,
sentences.zh: 最后，所以今天，我代表

sentences.en: McMaster said, trying to do the right thing but breaking a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统，表达美国对继续与欧盟合作和建立伙伴关系的坚定承诺，是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Finally, And so today it is my privilege on behalf of
sentences.zh: 在欧洲，

sentences.en: President Trump to express the strong commitment of the
sentences.zh: 副总统迈克·彭斯正试图让美国盟友放心，

sentences.en: United States to continued cooperation and partnership with the European Union.
